entries.title: Role activation proposal

entries.title: Team template proposal

entries.title: Workforce manager projection

entries.title: Workforce control intent

entries.title: Client workforce controls surface
entries.description: Existing Workforce surface contribution for governed client workforce controls.

entries.title: Deterministic risk classification
entries.description: Classify company-scoped intelligence items without granting execution authority.

entries.title: Independent intelligence teams
entries.description: Run independent Team A/B/C assessments with evidence-preserving challenge paths.

entries.title: Convergence and divergence intelligence
entries.description: Assess agreement, disagreement, severity and shared blind spots without averaging away conflicts.

entries.title: Adversarial challenge
entries.description: Challenge high-risk agreement and evidence blind spots before synthesis.

entries.title: Zero synthesis
entries.description: Synthesize sealed independent assessments into a company-scoped intelligence state; synthesis does not authorize effects.

entries.title: Dynamic intelligence topology
entries.description: Select bounded intelligence processing topology based on context, evidence and risk.

entries.title: Semantic and reality provenance evidence
entries.description: Create sealed semantic evidence and reality/provenance records.

entries.title: Consequence intelligence
entries.description: Assess downstream consequences and acceptance gates before consequential action.

entries.title: Decision packet projection
entries.description: Build authority-neutral decision packets, feeds, explanations, correlations and rewind projections.

entries.title: Local Ollama intelligence provider
entries.description: Discover and use loopback Ollama models as local intelligence without conferring authority.

entries.title: OpenRouter BYO provider

entries.title: Perplexity research provider
entries.description: Expose Perplexity as an optional BYO research provider descriptor with policy and budget gating.

entries.title: Model council orchestration
entries.description: Coordinate multiple model assessments for bounded comparison and synthesis without granting action authority.

entries.title: Multi-model routing
entries.description: Route eligible intelligence requests across configured providers using Titan resource-order, budget and policy constraints.

entries.title: Deep research workflow
entries.description: Run provenance-preserving deep research workflows through configured providers and return evidence for review.

entries.title: File-grounded chat
entries.description: Ground conversations in selected company-scoped files without changing source authority.

entries.title: Folder context assembly
entries.description: Assemble bounded company-scoped folder context for intelligence workflows.

entries.title: Gmail channel capability

entries.title: Slack channel capability

entries.title: WhatsApp channel capability

entries.title: Xero accounting integration

entries.title: Maps business intelligence

entries.title: External conversational booking

entries.title: Conversation customer tags

entries.title: Conversation review and feedback
entries.description: Capture review/feedback configuration and evidence without granting publication authority.

entries.title: External voice chat descriptor

entries.title: External web chat descriptor

entries.description: Read the current value of one canonical Titan Zero setting or preference without changing it.

entries.title: List Settings
entries.description: Show list open current Titan Zero settings and preferences without changing them.
